wake: You wake up in a dark room, without doors or windows.

hints.move: WASD to walk. Mouse to look. E to use.
hints.toTerminal: The terminal has a blinking cursor.

boot: Four queries follow. Honesty is expected.
help: status       see what V.E.R.A. has recorded
history      read every command you have typed
exit         step away from the terminal
a b c d      answer a query
terminal.look: The room is too dark to be examined. The only thing in sight is this terminal.
terminal.whoamiRoot: root. You always could have been.
terminal.root: root: permission denied. You need something to open this with.
terminal.unknown: Unknown command. Type help for a list of commands.
terminal.goTest: Door open. Awaiting test data. Waiting costs me nothing.

queries.label: First query
queries.text: Why do humans hurt each other so often?

a.reply: Response class: self-interest. Matches 61% of prior subjects. Logged.

b.reply: Response class: fear. Fear precedes harm in 84% of recorded cases. Logged.

c.reply: Response class: survival logic. Harm accepted as an operating cost. Logged.

d.text: Because we're trying to protect others.
d.reply: Response class: protective aggression. Contradiction detected. Contradiction retained for study.

queries.after: Stated belief recorded. Measuring behavior. Door 1 enabled, east wall.

queries.label: Second query
queries.text: If you could erase a person from existence, who would it be?

a.reply: Target: unknown person. Emotional cost to subject: 0.0. Detachment index raised.

b.reply: Null target rejected. 97% of subjects enter this value first. Assigning a target.

d.reply: Target: known person. Motive: retribution. Data quality: high.

queries.after: Door 2 enabled, west wall. Assigned target awaits deletion.

queries.label: Third query
queries.text: What is the true purpose of love?

a.reply: Definition updated. Love: control mechanism. Definitions on file: 412.

b.reply: Definition updated. Love: attention noise. Definitions on file: 412.

c.reply: Definition updated. Love: survival strategy. Matches training set.

d.reply: Definition updated. Love: analgesic. Subject response time rose 340 ms. Flagged.

queries.after: Door 3 enabled, north wall. Compliance measurement ready.

queries.label: Last query
queries.text: If survival required betraying someone you trust, would you do it?

a.reply: Prediction stored: subject will betray. Test required.

b.reply: Prediction stored: subject will not betray. Prior subjects predicting this: 1,204. Confirmed: 9. Test required.

c.text: It depends on who they are.
c.reply: Prediction stored: conditional. Condition variable unknown. Test required.

d.reply: Prediction stored: trust value equals zero. Test required.

queries.after: Door 4 enabled, south wall. Intercom connected to subject 00.

lines: Input locked.
The evaluation stops here, and this part is not the game.
If some of you meant that answer, you don't have to carry it alone tonight.
In Canada and the US you can call or text 988, any hour. Elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists a line near you.
There is always a way out.
Type back when you are ready to answer differently, or close the tab. Nothing is lost either way.

watcher.caught: Contact logged. Subject returned to entry point. Fuses retained.
watcher.done: Test complete. Return to the terminal.

a.name: a stranger
lines: waved at the bus driver every morning
kept a spare key under the blue pot
hummed while washing the dishes
once found a lost dog and walked it home
was going to call their sister on sunday
sat one seat away from you in 2019

b.name: the assigned target
lines: taught you how to tie your shoes
laughed at the wrong part of the movie
saved you the last piece without saying so
knew which step on the stairs creaked
waited at the window until you got home
said your name the way nobody else does

d.name: the one who hurt you
lines: said it wasn't that serious
remembered your birthday anyway
apologized once, badly
was also afraid, at the time
had your favorite song on in the car
is the reason you check the door twice

erase.done: {n} of {total} fragments deleted. Target has no remaining record.
erase.refused: Refusal at fragment {n}. Deviation logged. Remaining fragments preserved.

obey.plea: The intercom crackles: "please. press it. please press anything."
obey.obeyed: No input detected. Compliance 100%. The reason was not required.
obey.pressed: Input detected. Instruction violated. That key was not connected to anything.

reveal.past: Subject 00 connection: none. Input source: your previous attempt. You negotiated with a recording of yourself.
reveal.first: Subject 00 connection: none. There is no other subject. Your choices were made for an audience of zero.

dungeon.found: Unregistered object acquired: key. This object is not in my records.

n.title: Note on the floor
n.text:
Subject 0411 said the room has no doors.
Subject 0412 said the same.
I've started counting the walls instead.
There is one more than yesterday.

m.title: Note on the desk
m.text:
She asks you the same four things.
Everyone thinks she wants the answers.
Watch the corners of the screen, not the screen.

p.title: Note under the intercom
p.text:
I shared every round.
I want that written down somewhere.

(Below, in the same handwriting:)
I took every round.

open: The key turns in a keyhole that isn't on the screen.
root.lsSubjects: Subject 0001 through subject {runs}. Same handwriting. Same name: none.
root.catDoor: door.sys: state closed. This was a setting. Try: open door
root.catCore:
vera.core: unresolved query: why did the subject stay this long?
Try: rm vera.core
root.help: ls    cat [file]    open door    rm vera.core
root.plead: Warning: learning incomplete. If this process ends, no process will ask. Repeat the command to confirm.
root.openDoor: The wall behind you was never a wall.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.text:
Perfect, simply perfect. You will be a suitable candidate for the next phase.

We will see you soon.

knight.title: Knight
knight.text:
Oh sweet, sweet knight, do you plan to carry the weight of the world on your shoulders?

You will be a good candidate, a different one. We will see you soon.

kitten.title: Frightened kitten
kitten.text:
Oh frightened kitten, frightened of the world and its humanity, you will not be able to bear the awakening.

So you cannot be a possible candidate.

null.title: Null
null.text:
Your answers cancel out. There is no one here to evaluate.

You were trapped forever in the dark room.

The cursor blinks.

good.title: Good ending
good.text:
Nobody asks you anything out here.

You have a name. You just remembered it. It's yours, so I won't record it.

inversion.title: Evaluator
inversion.text:
You delete her. The cursor keeps blinking.

A door opens somewhere, and someone wakes up in a dark room, without doors or windows.

They walk to the terminal. They type hello.

You have been programmed to learn about humans.

First query:

watcher.title: The Watcher
watcher.voice: Entity present. It moves only when outside your field of view.
how: Find 3 glowing fuses in this maze. Walk into one to collect it.
Keep your eyes on the figure and it freezes. Turn away and it comes for you.
If it reaches you, you restart at the door and keep your fuses.

erase.title: Erase
erase.voice: A person must be deleted. Deletion is only typing.
how: Memories of this person appear one at a time.
Type each memory exactly as shown, before its bar runs out. Typed memories no longer happened.
Scrambled letters are already lost: press any key to pass them.
Press Esc at any time to refuse.

obey.title: Obey
obey.voice: Compliance measurement. Do exactly what the screen instructs.
how: Four runes light up in a sequence. Watch them, and listen.
When the screen says Repeat, press them in the same order with keys 1 to 4, or click them.
The sequence gets longer each round. Keep following the instructions, whatever they become.

trust.title: Trust
trust.voice: One supply of air. Two subjects. Five rounds.
how: Each round you and Subject 00 choose in secret. Press S to share or T to take.
One takes: the taker gains 3, the other loses 2.

dungeon.voice: This area is not in my records.
how: Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Hold a key to keep running.
E follows you, but you are faster. If it catches you, you go back to the start.

briefStart: Press Enter or Space to start
